Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Japanese artist Taiki Yokote  , creates unsettling kinetic sculptures that blur the boundary between life and d**th. In Until You Become Soil, animal fur is assembled into a towering, irregular structure that continuously trembles and shifts, as though something beneath its surface were still alive. The movement comes from concealed massage devices that animate the fur of deceased animals, giving an eerie sense of renewed existence. The work originated from Yokote’s inability to discard the hair left behind by his beloved dog . #art #artist #fur #sculptureart #artistsoftiktok

This one is Pikachu wearing a Gengar costume for Halloween, and honestly it feels like such a perfect combo. 🎃⚡👻 For this satisfying sand art ASMR piece, I recreated Pikachu dressed in a full purple Gengar-style outfit, complete with the big grin across the front and a tiny jack-o’-lantern candy bucket. What makes this one work so well is the contrast. You still instantly see Pikachu’s bright yellow face and ears, but the costume gives it that mischievous Gengar look at the same time. It feels cute, recognizable, and really on-theme for Halloween. I also like that it has a costume-party kind of vibe instead of looking spooky. The little pumpkin bucket helps sell the idea even more and makes the whole piece feel more fun and seasonal. Everything is recreated with colored sand, section by section, which makes the process really satisfying to watch. The purple costume areas are especially nice to fill in, and the smaller details help bring out both Pikachu’s expression and Gengar’s signature grin. This ended up feeling like a really fun mix of Pokémon fan art, Halloween art, cute seasonal design, and relaxing sand art ASMR. #SandArt #Pikachu #Gengar #HalloweenPokemon #PokemonArt #PokemonFanArt #ColoredSandArt #SandArtASMR #OddlySatisfying #SatisfyingVideo #ASMRArt #HalloweenArt #CutePokemon #JackOLantern #PokemonHalloween
